sources.quote: You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts.
sources.supports: xAI release notes say cached prompts were available by May 29, 2025; they do not state the price or when the cache rates took effect.

sources.quote: Cached prompt tokens: Prompt tokens that were served from cache rather than recomputed
sources.supports: xAI defines the cached prompt token category on its current pricing page, but this does not establish its historical Grok 3 mini price.

notes: The available xAI release notes establish that cached prompts were available by May 29, but provide no historical Grok 3 mini rate or pricing-change date, so the prior $0.30/$0.50 rates cannot be confirmed or rejected as official. Internet Archive CDX requests returned HTTP 503 and direct snapshot requests returned 404, so no historical pricing snapshot could be checked.
